essence: The speaker has declared the initial form of the mantras for all Bhairavas.
The Kṣetrapāla mantra is defined by beginning with kṣauṃ, containing the elephant-syllable, and ending in ṅa.
The Kṣetrapāla mantra has Brahmā as sage, Gāyatra as metre, and Kṣetrapālaka as deity.
The six-limb procedure is declared using the seed endowed with the six long vowels.
Kṣetrapāla is to be visualized as round-faced, three-eyed, and bearing upward tawny matted hair.
